name: Grasping Gauntlet
description: A gauntlet of magical force clutches creatures trying to steal gear from the armory.
disable: DC 45 Arcana check, DC 45 Nature check, DC 45 Occultism check, or DC 45 Religion check to trick the hazard's magic into nullifying itself, DC 41 Athletics check to wrestle the gauntlet into submission, DC 39 Thievery check to slide an object into the gauntlet's grasp, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 41)

offensiveAbilities.name: Seize Thief
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the warded area

Effect A gauntleted hand reaches out from the ward and attempts a gauntlet Strike. The hazard has an Athletics modifier of +37 for its Grab (Escape DC 47).
